nodes.text: Show that\[R(3,k+1)-R(3,k)\to\infty\]as $k\to \infty$. Similarly, prove or disprove that\[R(3,k+1)-R(3,k)=o(k).\]

#544 : [Er81c] [Er93,p.339] graph theory | ramsey theory A problem of Erdős and Sós. It is known (see [165] ) that\[R(3,k) \asymp \frac{k^2}{\log k}.\]The OpenAI bound of [1014] implies that\[R(3,k+1)-R(3,k)\ll k^{-c}R(3,k)\]for some constant $c>0$. This problem is #8 in Ramsey Theory in the graphs problem collection. See also [165] and [1014] .
